Locator: Section3.2 PDF9–10 eq3.17 and endpoint selection PDF12; Section5 C3 PDF37

Text: Each pair of bottom-side mesh faces is connected at height equal to the Euclidean distance between their centroids, with endpoint cells in the cube.

Unitcube(0,1)^3. Uniform4x4x4 Cartesian mesh, regular/quasi-uniform. Bottomfacecenters(1/8,1/8,0),(7/8,7/8,0).

One square cell, degree-zero DG. Target interpreted as independent per-face degree-zero polynomials.

Locator: Section6 PDF46 local K Delta^T Delta paragraph, compared Eq2.2 PDF5

Text: Pair contribution uses Delta_ij=mean(phi_i on f_l)-mean(phi_j on f_m).

Degree0 constantbasis1 on each unitlengthface. Distinct boundaryfacepair with positiveK. Literal scalar-index interpretation of displayedDelta.
